Honest caveats

  • The 2025–26 seasons were looked at while building earlier versions, so the test is a retrospective replay, not a pristine holdout. V6 itself was chosen on 2023–24 validation only and scored on test once.
  • Ranges are the 80th percentile of validation errors per position. They are not a guarantee for any single player.
  • Historical rows use closing Vegas lines; live projections use the line available at refresh time.
  • Game-day active status, kickers, defenses and Week 1 are out of scope.

How it works

Data

Weekly player stats, schedules, Vegas lines, snap counts, rosters and injury reports from nflverse (CC BY 4.0), 2019–2026 regular seasons. Target: full-PPR points in the player's next scheduled game.

Features

Rolling 3/5-game and season averages, exponentially weighted form, career form, touchdown-free scoring, snap share and trend, prior-week injury flags, opponent points allowed, rest, home/away, spread and implied team total. Nothing from the target game is used.

Model

Blend of a LightGBM regressor and a two-stage hurdle model (chance of scoring × expected points). Candidates were compared on expanding-season validation; a new version replaces the old one only if it lowers both MAE and RMSE.
